cohort: 60 nulliparous women undergoing elective cesarean section.
finding: Magnesium sulfate significantly controlled and reduced complications of succinylcholine administration, including fasciculation and myoglobin levels, in nulliparous women undergoing elective C-section.
mod_finding: The study's findings are directly applicable to the context of elective cesarean sections, demonstrating magnesium sulfate's effectiveness in managing anesthetic complications during this mode of birth.
